baseline_contract: Use the complete published predict_baselines output. Validate positive finite five points and diagnostics history_count/prefix_sector_count/known_asof_contamination against actual encoder inputs. B4=sector_pace_scaled_median5; each reference delta=(point-B4)/B4. Gaussian fallback means status starts with fallback_. This module never fits or calls a predictive model.
checkpoint: Frozen pilot candidate S1/S2 ledger row. Require candidate_checkpoint is True, exact context event/driver/packet_sequence/sector/checkpoint clock/counter/local_epoch pairing. Only read current S1 for stage1; read the received S1 plus current S2 for stage2. Each source must be available at or before the own atomic packet; never inspect current Sector3 or stage1 Sector2.
context_fields: Exact booleans for known pit, neutralization, their union, unknown coverage and fresh pitout. CurrentInPit may be unknown. Epoch age uses context raw_epoch_start_ms; counter is observed, not canonical. Current TrackStatus snapshot must be strictly earlier than checkpoint; unrecognized/regressed/parse-gap state is marked unknown. Current yellow is raw code2, not an inferred flag.
expected_missingness: Stage1 s2_over_b4 is NaN; it must not read a stored later Sector2. Missing/unsupported optional position, tyre, speed and clock fields are NaN with explicit flags where declared. All returned values are Python floats, finite or NaN.
history: Metadata-first independent safeguard: retain only same event/driver, observed_valid_completed is True, available_ms strictly less than checkpoint_ms. Ignore future/equal-clock/wrong-driver/unvalidated records before accessing their numerical values. Sort by (available_ms,packet_sequence,completion_id), reject duplicate IDs, require at least3. Validate positive finite coherent prior 3sectors/fullLapTime and their received clocks when present. Final labels, CSV fields and targets are never read.
normalization: B4 is the shared positive full-lap scale. Current and historical duration/moment features divide by B4; B4 itself remains seconds. Counts/position/counter are raw reported numbers, ages are seconds. No train/test-fitted scalers or feature selection, no clipping of reported values. Undefined optional values or nonrepresentable transforms are NaN; never return infinity.
public_api: encode(checkpoint, history, context, baseline_result) -> dict[str,float]; FEATURES is the ordered immutable tuple. Output insertion order equals FEATURES.

rolling_statistics.historical_prefix: sum of historical firstk sectors where k=current stage
rolling_statistics.historical_remainder: historical full_lap_seconds minus historical prefix; preserve received rounding residual
rolling_statistics.historical_sector_features: Prior valid S1/S2/S3 last5 median and MAD are allowed; only current/later S3 is forbidden.
rolling_statistics.mad: median(abs(values-median(values))), unscaled; no Gaussian consistency multiplier
rolling_statistics.median: ordinary sample median, midpoint convention for even n
rolling_statistics.prefix_deviation: (current observed prefix - historical prefix median) / max(historical prefix MAD,0.1seconds)
rolling_statistics.trend: median of all pairwise (value[j]-value[i])/(j-i) for j>i, measured per retained valid completion, not canonical lap or tyre age
rolling_statistics.window_policy: Use last min(window,n) eligible own completions, chronological oldest first. Older inputs affect history_count only after they leave the last10 numerical window.

speed_fields: Latest received SpeedI1/SpeedI2/SpeedFL/SpeedST values in km/h with explicit missing indicators. Own packet equality is allowed; unavailable/future/regressed/invalid fields are missing. No current sector3 time is accessed.
suggested_commit: research(f1): encode causal sector prefixes and completed-history features
tests: Future history and source-value poisoning; later-sector exclusion; exact context/clock pairing; source chronology and duplicate checks; immutability; fixed order/types; robust moment equations/scale behavior; valid missingness and no infinities.
tyre_fields: Highest observed TimingAppData stint candidate and its sparse fields only. Compound one-hot categories SOFT,MEDIUM,HARD,INTERMEDIATE,WET,unknown. New accepts JSON bool or exact native strings true/false; other values are missing. StartLaps/TotalLaps are raw reported nonnegative fields, never canonical TyreLife. Per-field clocks are strictly earlier than checkpoint before values are read. Report index only with at least one available candidate field; no backward filling from a future stint. Include ages of latest available candidate field and compound field.
